solution.text:
The solubility is governed by $\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {solution }}$ i.e. $\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {solution }}=\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {lattice }}-\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {Hydration }}$.
Due to increase in size the magnitude of hydration energy decresaes and hence the solubility.
